column1: 30001§case§keɪs§n. 论据；理由；情况，情形；案例；（法律）诉讼案件§Support can be found for a strong case that either Hamilton or Madison was the sole author of "The Senate."§无论主张《参议院》的唯一作者是汉密尔顿还是麦迪逊，都能找到支持这一论点的有力**论据**。§Economists have long observed that firms in related industries tend to cluster in the same area, as is the case in Leeds, UK, where many thread and yarn spinning firms as well as textile weaving firms are located.§经济学家早就注意到，相关行业的企业往往聚集在同一地区——英国利兹**就是如此**：许多纱线纺织企业与织物织造企业都设在当地。§§make the case that… 论证、主张…；a strong case that… 支持…的有力论据；as is / was the case …的情况也是如此；in each case 在每一个案例中；in any case 无论如何；case study 个案研究§a strong case 不是「一个有力的案例」，case ≈ argument / evidence，义为「论据、理由」；义项随搭配在「论点 / 情形 / 案例」之间切换，不可一律译成「案例」§删评论

30002§agency§ˈeɪdʒənsi§n. 能动性，自主行动能力；（政府）部门，机构；代理机构；作用，力量§Japa Pallikkathayil has advanced one answer by appealing to a duty to respect others’ agential interests: the possession of false beliefs constrains agency, and thus we ought not to impede the formation of true beliefs unless doing so prevents a greater constraint on someone’s agency or an otherwise impermissible end.§贾帕·帕利卡泰尔提出了一种回答，诉诸「尊重他人能动性利益」的义务：持有虚假信念会限制**能动性**，因此我们不应阻碍真信念的形成，除非这样做能防止对他人能动性更大的限制或其他不被允许的后果。§But Nixon’s legacy is complex: he has been praised for his role in creating the Environmental Protection Agency, and he once made an attempt at reforming United States health care policy that is arguably a precursor to the Affordable Care Act, which became law during the Barack Obama administration.§但尼克松的遗产是复杂的：他因在创建美国国家**环境保护局**（EPA）中扮演的角色而受到赞誉，而他当年对美国医疗政策的一次改革尝试，也可以说是《平价医疗法案》的先声——后者在奥巴马任内成为法律。§§constrain / give / deny agency 限制 / 赋予 / 剥夺能动性；by the agency of 借助……的力量；through human agency 通过人的作为；Environmental Protection Agency 环境保护局§核心义是哲学、社会学的「能动性、自主行动能力」；SAT 常以「政府机构、代理机构」这一常见义作干扰项§改译文：末句把 an otherwise impermissible end 误译成「本身就是不被允许的目的」

30003§lineage§ˈlɪniɪdʒ§n. 血统；家系；（生物）谱系，支系；（思想、技艺的）师承，流派传承§Working with a large sample of honey bee specimens collected from most US states, the researchers determined that there are just three maternal evolutionary lineages in the populations: the North Mediterranean lineage, the West Mediterranean lineage, and the African lineage.§研究者对采集自美国大部分州的大量蜜蜂标本进行分析，确定这些种群中只有三个母系演化**支系**：北地中海支系、西地中海支系和非洲支系。§In Rhythm Lineage, Maya Johnson, René Baptiste, and other dancers seamlessly interweave recent dance styles, including house and waacking, with elements of the Lindy Hop, a popular swing dance of the 1930s with roots in the Black American community of Harlem, New York.§在《节奏**传承**》（Rhythm Lineage）中，Maya Johnson、René Baptiste 等舞者将浩室舞、甩手舞等当代舞风，与林迪舞的元素无缝交织——林迪舞是 1930 年代流行的摇摆舞，植根于纽约哈莱姆的非裔美国人社区。§§maternal evolutionary lineage 母系演化支系§§改译文2：片名未译，补出 Lineage 的译名以标出本词

30004§convergence§kənˈvɜːdʒəns§n. （生物）趋同（演化）；（观点、趋势、数据的）趋于一致；（数学）收敛§Meanwhile, Cynthia C. Steiner and colleagues have investigated how convergence occurs through different genetic mechanisms, but the relative prevalence of convergence through shared and different genetic processes is still poorly understood.§与此同时，Cynthia C. Steiner 及其同事研究了**趋同现象**如何通过不同的遗传机制发生，但经由共享遗传过程与不同遗传过程实现的趋同，其相对普遍程度仍不清楚。§§§§convergent evolution 趋同演化§与 divergence（分化、分歧）相对§

30005§curate§kjʊˈreɪt§v. 策划（展览）；为展览挑选编排作品；精心挑选并编排（歌单、内容）§The Reckoning and Resilience (2022) exhibition at Duke University’s Nasher Museum of Art in Durham, North Carolina, was curated to feature the work of thirty North Carolina artists.§在北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市杜克大学纳舍艺术博物馆举办的《清算与韧性》（2022）展览，其**策展**重点是呈现三十位北卡罗来纳州艺术家的作品。§Such stylistic diversity is encouraged in part by the music-streaming app Spotify, whose curated playlist of hyperpop songs balances cohesion with variety.§这种风格多样性部分得益于音乐流媒体应用 Spotify——它那**精心编排**的 hyperpop 歌单在凝聚力与多样性之间取得了平衡。§§curated playlist 精心编排的歌单；curation n. 策展；策划；curator n. 策展人（真题另现 17 次）§curate ≠ create：curate 的核心是从既有材料中挑选并编排，不强调原创；「人」用 curator，动作才是 curate§

30006§manifest§ˈmænɪfest§v. 显现；表现出 adj. 明显的；显而易见的 n. （船、飞机的）载货清单§Yes, the great cloud was ravelling, discovering here and there a pale and dying sky, and the sun, already down, was manifest in the livid tongues of fire darting towards the zenith, falling and darting again, ever more pale and languid, and doomed no sooner lit to be extinguished.§是的，那大片云彩正在舒卷绽开，这里那里露出一角苍白垂死的天空；已沉落的太阳**显形**于冲天疾窜的青灰色火舌之中——落了又窜，愈发苍白无力，刚一闪亮便注定熄灭。§Etta-Nkwelle posited that herding would manifest in regional peer countries converging on the same foreign currency accumulation rate regardless of each country’s observable circumstances.§Etta-Nkwelle 提出：「羊群效应」会**表现为**同一地区的伙伴国家不管各自可观察到的实际处境如何，都趋同于相同的外汇积累速率。§§manifest as / in 以……形式表现出来；manifest injustice 显失公平§名词义「载货清单」与动词义无关，需区分§

30007§prolific§prəˈlɪfɪk§adj. （作家、艺术家）多产的，作品多的；（生物）繁殖力强的§But not all Highwaymen fully embraced this approach; for instance, though Willie Reagan was also prolific, his paintings were executed with greater attention to detail.§但并非所有「佛罗里达公路客」都完全采用这种做法；例如，Willie Reagan 虽然同样**多产**，他的画作却更注重细节。§Mexican architect Luis Barragan's prolific career, which spanned the 1920s to the 1980s, evolved through distinct phases.§墨西哥建筑师路易斯·巴拉干**多产**的职业生涯横跨 1920 年代至 1980 年代，经历了若干截然不同的阶段。§§§prolific 与 productive 的区别在于强调「量大且持续」§改译文：原译文是另一句（讲公路客画派的构图与题材）

30008§discrepancy§dɪˈskrepənsi§n. 差异；不一致；矛盾之处§This discrepancy is explicable in terms of OFT: the monkeys' greater reliance on vision means that higher lunar intensity benefits them more than it benefits the mice.§这一**差异**可以用最优觅食理论（OFT）来解释：猴子对视觉的依赖更强，因此月光增强对它们的益处超过对鼠类的益处。§Savoca and colleagues resolve this apparent discrepancy by pointing out that baleen whales cycle iron in the ocean, helping support phytoplankton populations, which, in turn, sustain krill populations.§Savoca 及同事通过指出须鲸在海洋中循环铁元素、帮助维持浮游植物种群——进而支撑磷虾种群——化解了这一明显的**矛盾**。§§explain / account for the discrepancy 解释这一差异（真题高频）；discrepant adj. 有出入的；不一致的（真题：too sparse and discrepant）§与 discredit 形近异义：discredit 是「使受怀疑；败坏名声」§

30009§mitigate§ˈmɪtɪɡeɪt§v. 减轻；缓解；缓和（问题、风险、痛苦）§Ethicist Ingrid Robeyns argues in her work that taxes on the very wealthy should be increased so that governments will be enabled to solve problems of collective action, such as mitigating climate change.§伦理学家英格丽德·罗本斯在其著作中主张，应提高对巨富阶层的征税，使政府有能力解决集体行动问题，例如**减缓**气候变化。§But they note that this damage can be mitigated: building vapor barriers between structural foundations and the soil can significantly reduce the effects of soil swelling and shrinking.§但他们指出这种损害是可以**缓解**的：在地基与土壤之间修建隔汽层，能显著减轻土壤胀缩的影响。§§mitigate a problem / risk 减轻问题 / 风险§不是「消除」：真题里 mitigate these challenges 后仍说 success has been constrained，即只缓和、未解决§改译文：原译文是另一句（配送机器人）

30010§precursor§prɪˈkɜːsə§n. 前身；雏形；先兆，前兆；（化学、生物）前体§But Nixon's legacy is complex: he has been praised for his role in opening relations between the United States and China, and he once made an attempt at reforming United States health care policy that is arguably a precursor to the Affordable Care Act, which became law during the Barack Obama administration.§但尼克松的政治遗产是复杂的：他因推动美中关系正常化而受到赞誉，他还曾尝试改革美国医疗保障政策，那项尝试可以说是《平价医疗法案》的**前身**，该法案在巴拉克·奥巴马执政期间成为法律。§Paris Opera Ballet dancer Marie Camargo introduced a seemingly simple innovation to the ballet world of the 1730s by removing the heels from her dance shoes, creating the precursor to today’s soft ballet slipper.§巴黎歌剧院芭蕾舞者 Marie Camargo 给 1730 年代的芭蕾界带来了一项看似简单的革新——去掉舞鞋的鞋跟，由此成为今日软底芭蕾舞鞋的**前身**。§§precursor to …的前身，雏形；a precursor of change 变化的先兆§§改例句：「complex;:」多了一个分号

30011§protagonist§prəˈtæɡənɪst§n. 主人公；主角；（运动、争议中的）核心人物，积极倡导者§Scott Fitzgerald's 1920 novel This Side of Paradise contains elements drawn from Fitzgerald's own life—there are many parallels between the experiences of the novel's protagonist, Amory Blaine, and those of Fitzgerald—and as a result This Side of Paradise is regularly described as an autobiographical novel.§菲茨杰拉德 1920 年的小说《人间天堂》含有取材于他本人经历的元素——小说**主人公**艾默里·布莱恩的经历与菲茨杰拉德的经历有许多相似之处，因此《人间天堂》常被描述为一部自传体小说。§§§§a protagonist of reform 改革的积极推动者§与 antagonist（反派、对手）相对§

30012§mediate§ˈmiːdieɪt§v. 介导；（作为中介）传导，促成；调解，斡旋§By persistently modifying the voice, hyperpop invites the listener to reflect on the extent to which digital technology mediates the human experience today.§通过持续对人声进行改造，hyperpop 引导听者反思：数字技术在多大程度上**中介着**当今的人类经验。§Subsequent investigation of potential selection mechanisms prompted the researchers to conclude that independent of avian order, the prevalence of the trait is mediated by environmental variations associated with the absolute latitude of brooding sites.§对潜在选择机制的后续研究促使学者们得出结论：与鸟类目无关，该性状的普遍程度受繁殖地绝对纬度相关的环境差异所**调节**。§§mediate between A and B 在 A 与 B 之间调解；X-mediated 由 X 介导的（microorganism-mediated cycling）；mediation n. 中介作用；mediator n. 中介者§科研语境 X mediates Y 指 X 决定或传导 Y；immediate 与之同根：im-（无）+ mediate，字面「无中介的」§

30013§sophisticate§səˈfɪstɪkeɪt§adj. （sophisticated）精密的；尖端的；老练的；有品味的 v. 使复杂化；使老练§The British Bronze Age began when sophisticated techniques for making tools, weapons, and other objects from metal were introduced to the British Isles around 2500 BCE, and it lasted until around 700 BCE.§英国青铜时代始于约公元前 2500 年——当时用金属制造工具、武器及其他器物的**精密**技术传入不列颠群岛——一直延续到约公元前 700 年。§Studies conducted in individual Western societies have demonstrated associations between personality traits and five musical factors (mellowness, unpretentiousness, sophistication, intensity, and contemporariness) underlying individual preferences for styles of Western music.§在西方单一社会中进行的研究已证明：人格特质与偏好西方音乐风格的个体差异背后的五个音乐因子（柔和、朴实、**精致**、强度、当代性）之间存在关联。§§sophisticated adj. 精密的；老练的（真题唯一形态，29 次）；sophistication n. 精密（程度）；老练§sophisticated 科技语境多指「精密的」，形容人指「老练的、有品味的」，均非贬义；sophistication 与 sophistry（诡辩，贬义）形近异义§

30014§tariff§ˈtærɪf§n. 关税；（旅馆、服务的）收费表，价目表§In a 2021 report, economist Jayson Beckman modeled global market prices of several agricultural commodities under both the TFA and an alternative trade-reform scenario: removal of agricultural tariffs (taxes on imports that generally increase prices on imported goods).§经济学家 Jayson Beckman 在 2021 年的一份报告中建模比较了几种农产品的全球市场价格：一种情形是《贸易便利化协定》（TFA），另一种是替代性贸易改革方案——取消农业**关税**（关税即对进口商品征收的税，通常会抬高进口商品的价格）。§To measure whether countries in free trade agreements (FTAs)—agreements among nations to reduce tariffs, duties, and other trade barriers—experience changes in total agricultural exports, economist Kayode Ajewole and colleagues calculated average export growth rates for several countries over the five years before and the five years after entering an FTA with the United States.§为衡量签署自由贸易协定（FTA——国家间降低**关税**、各类税费及其他贸易壁垒的协定）的国家农产品出口总额是否变化，经济学家 Kayode Ajewole 及同事计算了多个国家与美国签订 FTA 前后各五年的平均出口增长率。§§impose tariffs 征收关税；eliminate tariffs 取消关税§常与 quota（配额）并考§改译文2：漏译 duties

30015§harbor§ˈhɑːbə(r)§v. （某地）栖息着，含有（物种、物质）；怀有（想法、情绪）；窝藏 n. 港口§With its distinct water chemistry, temperature, and life-forms, the HZ harbors great biodiversity, including microbes that play a key role in regulating trace element removal and other critical ecological processes.§凭借独特的水化学、温度和生命形态，该潜流带**孕育着**丰富的生物多样性，包括在调控微量元素去除等关键生态过程中发挥作用的微生物。§In a paper for an art history class, a student claims that Agnes Martin's 1957 painting Harbor Number 1 marks a significant change in Martin's artistic development.§在一篇艺术史课程论文中，一位学生主张：Agnes Martin 1957 年的画作《**港口**一号》标志着她艺术发展的重大转变。§§harbor great biodiversity 栖息着丰富的生物多样性；harbor doubts 心存疑虑；harbor resentment 怀恨在心；harbor seal 港海豹§「怀有（想法、情绪）而不表露」是 SAT 最常考的抽象义§改译文：HZ 指潜流带（hyporheic zone），不是热液区

30016§hoard§hɔːd§n. （钱币、金属器物的）窖藏；贮藏物 v. 囤积；贮藏§Collections of metal items (called hoards) from all periods of the Bronze Age have been found in Britain, including the Llanarmon-yn-lal hoard of artifacts from the 16th century BCE, unearthed around 1982, and the much later Horsehope Craig hoard of artifacts from the 7th century BCE, unearthed around 1865.§在英国已发现各个时期青铜时代的金属器物收藏（称为「**窖藏**」），包括约 1982 年出土的公元前 16 世纪 Llanarmon-yn-lal 器物窖藏，以及年代晚得多、约 1865 年出土的公元前 7 世纪 Horsehope Craig 器物窖藏。§For hoards discovered since the 1960s, such as the 1965 discovery of the Walderslade hoard, advancements like inexpensive metal detectors, ground penetrating radar, and aerial surveys have made it much easier for searchers to locate hoards before putting the first shovel in the ground.§对 1960 年代以后发现的**窖藏**（如 1965 年发现的 Walderslade 窖藏）而言，廉价金属探测器、探地雷达与航空勘测等进步，使寻宝者在动第一铲之前就更容易定位窖藏。§§a hoard of artifacts 一批器物窖藏（真题搭配）；hoard food / information 囤积食物 / 信息§与 horde 同音异义：horde 是「一大群人；游牧部落」§

30017§inhibit§ɪnˈhɪbɪt§v. 抑制；阻碍（过程、活动、生长）；使拘谨，使不敢自如表现§Isolates are more prevalent in mountainous regions, likely because challenging terrain inhibits the geographical expansion of language families.§孤立语言在山区更为普遍，可能是因为崎岖的地形**阻碍**了语系的地理扩张。§All stainless steel contains varying amounts of iron, carbon, and corrosion-inhibiting chromium.§所有不锈钢都含有不同比例的铁、碳和**抗腐蚀**的铬。§§inhibition n. 抑制（作用）；inhibitor n. 抑制剂§与 exhibit 形近异义：exhibit 是「展出；表现出」§改译文：原译文是另一句（诗体之争）

30018§paradigm§ˈpærədaɪm§n. 范式；（学科共用的）理论框架；典范，样板§Indeed, contrary to the popular myth of the lone genius, theirs is not the first paradigm-shifting theory to have emerged from multiple scholars working in parallel.§的确，与「孤胆天才」的流俗神话相反，它们并不是第一个由多名学者并行研究而涌现出的**范式转移**理论。§Note "putatively": as Gavin Kennedy has shown, Smith deploys this metaphor only once in his economic writings—to make a narrow point about the then-dominant economic theory of mercantilism—and it was largely ignored until some twentieth-century economists eager to secure an intellectual pedigree for their views elevated it to a fully-fledged paradigm.§注意「所谓」二字：正如 Gavin Kennedy 所证实的，斯密在其经济学著述中仅使用过这一隐喻一次——只为就当时占主导的重商主义理论提出一个狭隘论点——此后它基本无人问津，直到二十世纪一些急于为自己的观点寻找思想谱系的经济学家，才把它抬升为羽翼丰满的**范式**。§§paradigm shift 范式转换；methodological paradigms 方法论范式§§改例句2：删去破折号后的一串不可见零宽字符

30019§premium§ˈpriːmiəm§n. 溢价，额外费用；保险费 adj. 高级的；优质的§Luis Aguiar studied the effect of the 2011 implementation of a restriction on the free version of the French streaming service Deezer: its unlimited usage was reduced to five hours a month, while the paid premium version’s usage remained unlimited.§路易斯·阿吉亚尔研究了 2011 年法国流媒体服务 Deezer 对免费版实施限制的效果：其无限使用时长被削减到每月五小时，而付费**高级版**的时长则保持不限。§Mariana Lopes Barata and Pedro Simões Coelho collected data from 324 music-streaming service users to identify factors that influence users to opt for paid (premium) versions of music streaming services, like Apple Music.§Mariana Lopes Barata 与 Pedro Simões Coelho 收集了 324 名音乐流媒体服务用户的数据，以识别影响用户选择 Apple Music 等音乐流媒体服务付费（**高级**）版本的因素。§§pay a premium for 为……多付钱；price premium 价格溢价；premium version / service 高级版 / 高端服务；at a premium 稀缺而昂贵；put a premium on 重视§保险语境指投保人按期缴纳的「保费」§改译文2：漏译「如 Apple Music」，并补出 premium 的译名

30020§impede§ɪmˈpiːd§v. 阻碍；妨碍（进展、运动、视线）§Creeping dogwood (Cornus canadensis) plants are native to Alaska, where harsh conditions have historically impeded potential invasive species.§草茱萸（Cornus canadensis）原产于阿拉斯加，那里严酷的环境条件历来**阻挡**了潜在的入侵物种。§The morphological novelty of echinoderms—marine invertebrates with radial symmetry, usually starlike, around a central point—impedes comparisons with most other animals, in which bilateral symmetry on an anterior-posterior (head to tail) axis through a trunk is typical.§棘皮动物——具辐射对称（通常呈星形、围绕中心点）的海洋无脊椎动物——的形态学新奇性，**妨碍**了与多数其他动物的比较；后者典型特征是躯干沿前后（头到尾）轴的两侧对称。§[构词] im-（在内）+ ped（脚）→ 绊住脚§impediment n. 障碍；（言语）障碍，口吃§与 impel 形近而方向相反：impel 是「推动、促使」§

30021§probability§ˌprɒbəˈbɪləti§n. 概率；几率；可能性§if you flip a coin 1,000 times, there is a 99.7% probability that the coin will land heads side up between 450 and 550 times.§抛一枚硬币 1000 次，正面朝上的次数落在 450 到 550 次之间的**概率**（probability）为 99.7%。§§§[构词] probable（很可能的）+ -ility；反义 improbability§a 99.7% probability that… 有 99.7% 的概率……；the probability of success 成功概率；probabilities 复数形态（真题 1 次：multiple probabilities 多种概率取值）§probability 可量化（带百分比或 0–1 数值），更近「概率、几率」；possibility 只问「有没有可能」，不谈大小，真题多作 to evaluate this possibility（待检验的假设）§删例句2：不含本词（句中是 possibility）

30022§leverage§ˈliːvərɪdʒ§v. 利用（已有资源）；借力 n. 杠杆作用；（金融）杠杆；影响力，筹码§The Virgin Group's introduction of the Virgin Atlantic airline in 1984 is an instance of brand extension—the company leveraged its brand recognition as a music retailer to enter a product category where it had not previously competed.§维珍集团 1984 年推出维珍大西洋航空，是品牌延伸的一例——公司**利用**其作为音乐零售商的品牌知名度，进入了一个此前并未参与的品类。§In his 2023 collection The Diaspora Sonnets, Filipino American poet Oliver de la Paz leverages the sonnet form’s “diamond-like quality of precision,” as he describes it.§在 2023 年的诗集《离散十四行诗》中，菲律宾裔美国诗人 Oliver de la Paz **借用**了十四行诗体「钻石般的精准质地」（他自己的说法）。§§leverage its brand recognition 利用其品牌知名度；financial leverage 财务杠杆；high leverage 高杠杆；political leverage 政治筹码§§

30023§levy§ˈlevi§v. 征收（税款）；课以（罚款）；征集（兵员） n. 征税；税款§Moreover, enforcement was generally limited to fines, which, when levied against high‑profile offenders, were widely announced.§此外，执法通常仅限于罚款；而对高知名度违法者**处以**罚款时，往往会被广泛报道。§§§§fines levied against offenders 对违法者课以罚款；a levy on imports 进口税；levy troops 征兵；levied 本词真题形态（真题 1 次：levied against high-profile offenders）§levy 强调「强制收取」；与 leverage（借力利用）、lever、elevate 同出拉丁 levare（举升），但 leverage 强调「借力打力」，切勿因形近而混§改译文：原译未译出 levied，调整语序以对应；删例句2：不含本词（句中是 leveraged，非 levy 的变形）

30024§surplus§ˈsɜːpləs§n. 盈余；过剩；剩余（物） adj. 过剩的；剩余的；多余的§John Iliffe and other Africanist scholars have shown, however, that in parts of Africa, surplus capital accrual, the existence of salaried labor, and other features of capitalism predated colonization.§然而，John Iliffe 等非洲研究学者已经表明，在非洲部分地区，**剩余**资本的积累、雇佣劳动的存在以及资本主义的其他特征，都早于殖民化出现。§While people who pursue other art forms—sculpture, film, theater—require large blocks of uninterrupted time as well as money to complete their work, poets can write, as Lorde said, "between shifts, in the hospital pantry, on the subway, and on scraps of surplus paper." So poets can make worthwhile art even if they must earn their living in another way.§从事其他艺术形式——雕塑、电影、戏剧——的人需要大段不被打断的时间和金钱才能完成作品，而诗人却可以像 Lorde 说的那样「在轮班之间、在医院配餐间、在地铁上、在**多余**的纸片上」写作。因此，即便诗人必须另谋生计，也能创作出有价值的艺术。§§budget surplus 预算盈余；surplus goods 剩余商品；surplus labor 剩余劳动力；surplus value 剩余价值§§改译文：原译文人名和内容都是另一句；改例句2：「paper."So」引号后补空格

30025§acclaim§əˈkleɪm§v. 高度赞扬；推崇 n. 赞誉；喝彩§Her acclaimed 2019 young adult novel Ghost Bird is set in a Murri community in Queensland, Australia.§她 2019 年**广受好评**的青少年小说《幽灵鸟》以澳大利亚昆士兰的一个 Murri 社群为背景。§The Marsalis family is often referred to as "the first family of jazz." Four of the children of celebrated pianist Ellis Marsalis Jr. went on to become performers who are also critically acclaimed: drummer Jason, trombonist Delfeayo, saxophonist Branford, and trumpeter Wynton.§Marsalis 一家常被称为「爵士乐第一家庭」：著名钢琴家 Ellis Marsalis Jr. 的四个孩子后来都成为**广受好评**的演奏家——鼓手 Jason、长号手 Delfeayo、萨克斯手 Branford 和小号手 Wynton。§§acclaimed adj. 备受赞誉的（真题唯一形态，15 次）；widely acclaimed 广受赞誉的；critical acclaim 评论界的赞誉；acclamation n. 欢呼拥戴；（一致）口头表决通过§常用被动 be acclaimed / widely acclaimed§改例句2：「jazz. "」删去引号前多余的空格

30026§analogous§əˈnæləɡəs§adj. 类似的；可类比的；（生物）同功的§Probabilistic models generate predictions based on outcomes of analogous past events, but even as these models project likely outcomes, they implicitly acknowledge that lower-frequency events may occur instead.§概率模型依据**类似**的既往事件的结果来生成预测，但即便这些模型预测出可能的结果，它们也隐含地承认，发生频率较低的事件也可能出现。§Weitz assessed these trade-offs by comparing vascular function in the reticulate patterns of Alchornea ilicifolia (native holly) and other angiosperm leaf veins with that of analogous open-branching patterns.§Weitz 通过比较 Alchornea ilicifolia（冬青）等被子植物叶片网状脉序与**类似**的开放分支脉序的维管功能，来评估这些利弊权衡。§§analogous to / with X 与 X 类似；analogy n. 类比；by analogy with 依…类推；analogue n. 类似物 adj. 模拟的（与 digital 相对）§生物学「同功的」指功能相似但起源不同，与 homologous（同源的）相对§改译文：原译文是另一句（历史学家与地图）

30027§anvil§ˈænvɪl§n. 铁砧，砧台；（耳内的）砧骨§We trekked into a far country, My friend and I. Our deeper content was never spoken, But each knew all the other said. He told me how calm his soul was laid By the lack of anvil and strife. “The wooing kestrel,” I said, “mutes his mating-note To please the harmony of this sweet silence.”§我们跋涉进入一片遥远的乡野，我与我的友人。我们更深的心事从未说出口，但彼此都懂对方未言之意。他告诉我，因没有**铁砧**与纷争，他的灵魂是何等安宁静穆。「求偶的红隼，」我说，「压低了它的求偶之声，以应和这甜美寂静的和谐。」§By using fixed stones as anvils, tool-using otters gained access to high-quality, hard-shelled prey (e.g., mussels and clams) that they could usually not access through biting alone.§借助固定石块作**砧台**，会使用工具的水獭得以获取通常无法单靠撕咬打开的优质硬壳猎物（如贻贝和蛤蜊）。§§§诗中 the lack of anvil and strife 以「无砧」写没有劳作与争斗、心境宁静；SAT 文学题常考具体名词的抽象转喻§改例句：诗行换行丢失，四处行首前补空格（如 country,My）；改译文：漏译最后一句（红隼）

30028§archival§ɑːˈkaɪvl§adj. 档案的；（档案、文献）收藏的§In her exhibition Strike Gulf, she interrogated the impact of the oil and gas industry on southern Louisiana (where she grew up), incorporating core samples from deep seabeds off the Louisiana coast, oil well data, archival information about oil boycotts, and video she took in New Orleans.§在《Strike Gulf》展览中，她审视油气产业对南路易斯安那（她长大的地方）的影响，作品纳入了路易斯安那近海深部海床的岩芯样本、油井数据、关于石油抵制运动的**档案**资料，以及她在新奥尔良拍摄的影像。§One reason for this discrepancy is that historians of capitalism tend to focus on longitudinal economic data drawn from archival records, which do not exist for much of precolonial Africa.§造成这种差异的一个原因是：资本主义史学家倾向于关注取自**档案**记录的纵向经济数据，而前殖民时代的非洲大部分地区并不存在这类记录。§[构词] archive n. 档案 → archival adj.；注意与 archaeological（考古的）区分§archival information / records 档案资料 / 记录§§

30029§discourse§ˈdɪskɔːs§n. 话语；（某领域的）论述，言说方式；（语言学）语篇 v. 论述，讲述§A debate in paleontological discourse focuses on whether ancient pandas first emerged in Asia before migrating to Europe, or vice versa.§古生物学**论述**中的一场争论聚焦于：古代熊猫究竟是先出现在亚洲再迁往欧洲，还是相反。§§§§paleontological discourse 古生物学论述；public discourse 公共话语；discourse analysis 语篇分析；discourse on 论述（某题目）§§改译文：原译「古生物学界」未译出 discourse

30030§hermit§ˈhɜːmɪt§n. 隐士；隐居者；（stripe-throated hermit）隐蜂鸟§High-reward flowers that produce nectar with relatively high sugar concentrations are thought to be especially attractive to stripe-throated hermits and other hummingbird species.§糖分浓度较高的高回报花蜜型花朵，被认为对条纹喉**隐蜂鸟**及其他蜂鸟种类尤其具有吸引力。§Biologists Louise Roberts and Mark Laidre noticed that hermit crabs sometimes vibrate their shells and wondered if they do this to scare away other crabs.§生物学家 Louise Roberts 和 Mark Laidre 注意到**寄居蟹**有时会震动自己的壳，并猜想它们这样做是为了吓退其他螃蟹。§§stripe-throated hermit 条纹喉隐蜂鸟；hermit crab 寄居蟹§专名中的普通词常是 SAT 词义题考点：hermits 在真题里指一类蜂鸟，不是「隐士」§

30031§microorganism§ˌmaɪkrəʊˈɔːɡənɪzəm§n. 微生物§Microorganism-mediated nutrient cycling was accelerated in the transplanted cores; crucially, microorganism community composition was unchanged, allowing Kastovska et al. to attribute the acceleration to temperature-induced increases in microorganism activity.§在被移植的土芯中，由**微生物**介导的养分循环被加快了；关键在于微生物群落构成并未改变，这使得 Kastovska 等人得以把这种加快归因于温度上升带来的微生物活性提高。§Just like household dust on Earth, dust on the International Space Station (ISS) harbors hundreds of common microorganisms—Aspergillus hongkongensis and other fungi, along with bacteria, such as Staphylococcus pettenkoferi.§正如地球上的家居灰尘一样，国际空间站（ISS）上的灰尘也藏有数百种常见**微生物**——包括 Aspergillus hongkongensis 等真菌，以及 Staphylococcus pettenkoferi 等细菌。§[构词] micro-（微小）+ organism（生物体）§microbe n. 微生物（同义，真题另现 10 次）；microorganism-mediated adj. 微生物介导的（真题复合形容词）§§

30032§modernist§ˈmɒdnɪst§adj. （艺术、建筑）现代主义的 n. 现代主义者§As can be seen in the case of Others, a New York magazine published from July 1915 to July 1919, some small periodicals influential in the development of the modernist movement have been explored in depth by scholars.§正如《Others》一例所见——这本纽约杂志从 1915 年 7 月出版至 1919 年 7 月——一些对**现代主义**运动的发展颇有影响的小型期刊，已得到学者们的深入探究。§King were among the 300 artists who exhibited at the 1913 Armory Show, a groundbreaking New York City art exhibition that introduced modernism to American audiences.§King 等人均属于 1913 年军械库展的 300 位参展艺术家——这场开创性的纽约艺术展把**现代主义**介绍给了美国观众。§§modernist movement 现代主义运动；modernism n. 现代主义§现代主义风格主张功能优先、拒绝传统装饰；与 functionalist 并置时强调「形式服从功能」§

30033§respondent§rɪˈspɒndənt§n. （调查、问卷的）应答者，受访者；（上诉案件的）被上诉人§It may be tempting to assume the difference is due to different levels of access to parks; however, given that the percentage of Caracas respondents who reported living within a 10-minute walk of a park was much lower than that reported by Fortaleza respondents, greater proximity alone can’t explain the difference in park use.§人们很容易假定这一差异源于接触公园的机会不同；然而，鉴于加拉加斯报告「住在距公园步行 10 分钟范围内」的**受访者**比例远低于福塔莱萨的受访者，单靠「距离更近」是解释不通的。§The statements are categorized as relevant to one of six topics—e.g., statement 37, "I like when packages delivered to me are tightly packed," is categorized as relevant to the topic of visual appeal—and respondents rate the importance of each statement to their experience.§这些陈述被归入六个主题之一——例如第 37 条「我喜欢送到我手中的包裹被塞得紧紧实实」被归入「视觉吸引力」主题——**受访者**对每条陈述对其体验的重要程度打分。§§respond v. 回答；response n. 回应§与 correspondent 形近异义：correspondent 是「通讯员；记者」§

30034§stakeholder§ˈsteɪkhəʊldə(r)§n. 利益相关方，利益相关者；股东§Esther Sanye-Mengual, Kathrin Specht, and their team surveyed three groups of people in Bologna, Italy— leaders of urban agriculture projects, stakeholders in urban agriculture (e.g., food researchers and urban farming associations), and the general public—to compare their views about the extent to which urban agriculture contributes to 25 social or ecological services that the team identified.§埃丝特·桑耶-门瓜尔、卡特琳·施佩希特及其团队调查了意大利博洛尼亚的三类人群——城市农业项目的负责人、城市农业的**利益相关方**（如食品研究者和城市农艺协会）以及普通公众——以比较他们对城市农业在多大程度上促成该团队确定的 25 项社会或生态服务的看法。§Using only the rankings shown in the table, a city planner in Bologna who is promoting a new urban agriculture project concludes that advertisements aimed at stakeholders should emphasize the project's benefit to the enhancement of pollination.§仅凭表中所示的排名，博洛尼亚一位正在推广新城市农业项目的城市规划者得出结论：面向**利益相关方**的宣传应强调该项目对促进授粉的益处。§§stakeholders in urban agriculture 城市农业的利益相关方§金融语境指持股者，与 shareholder 常可互换§改译文：漏译「团队确定的 25 项」

30035§viable§ˈvaɪəbl§adj. 可行的；能运转的；（种子、胚胎）能存活的，能发育的；能自我维持的§The technology, while generating lots of interest, is not yet commercially viable as a large-scale energy source.§这项技术虽然备受关注，但作为大规模能源尚不具备商业**可行性**。§In 2022, Guillermo Restrepo calculated the historical rates at which newly discovered compounds have entered the scientific literature, expanding the “chemical space.” Using a conservative estimate of the number of viable compounds and assuming a doubling of the historical pace of discovery, Restrepo found that under these hypothetical conditions, all potential compounds could be synthesized and documented by 2050.§2022 年，Guillermo Restrepo 计算了新发现的化合物进入科学文献、从而拓展「化学空间」的历史速率。采用对**可行**化合物数量的保守估计，并假设发现速度翻倍，Restrepo 发现在这些假设条件下，所有潜在化合物都可在 2050 年前被合成并记录。§§a viable alternative 可行的替代方案；commercially viable 有商业可行性的；viable seeds 能发芽的种子§§

30036§amenity§əˈmiːnəti§n. （常作复数）便利设施；福利设施；舒适，宜人§This approach has some limits—data from Places API tend to be restricted to places that are customer facing—but the data set nonetheless provides an extremely reliable source to study colocation patterns of neighborhood amenities.§这一方法有某些局限——来自 Places API 的数据往往只覆盖面向顾客的场所——但该数据集仍不失为研究社区**便利设施**空间共置模式的极其可靠的来源。§Vancouver has high pedestrian traffic, but other cities cannot increase their pedestrian traffic simply by replicating a single feature of Vancouver—e.g., its high number of pedestrian amenities—that is associated with walkability.§温哥华行人流量很高，但其他城市无法仅靠复制温哥华的单一特征（如与步行友好性相关的密集步行**设施**）来提高自己的行人流量。§§amenities n.（复数）便利设施（真题 18 次全为复数）；neighborhood amenities 社区便利设施§与 amnesty 形近异义：amnesty 是「大赦」§

30037§authorship§ˈɔːθəʃɪp§n. 作者身份；（作品的）作者归属；写作，著述§Though the authorship of most of the individual essays is certain, that of a few is in question: for instance, while No. 37, "Concerning the Difficulties of the Convention in Devising a Proper Form of Government," was surely penned by Madison, No. 62, "The Senate," may have been written by either Hamilton or Madison.§尽管大多数单篇文章的**作者归属**是确定的，仍有几篇存疑：例如，虽然第 37 篇《关于制宪会议设计恰当政府形式之困难》无疑出自麦迪逊之手，第 62 篇《参议院》则可能由汉密尔顿或麦迪逊所写。§In a 1963 rebuttal, film critic Pauline Kael argued that film authorship should be shared among screenwriters, directors, and others involved in the filmmaking process.§在 1963 年的一篇反驳文章中，影评人 Pauline Kael 主张：电影的**作者身份**应由编剧、导演及其他参与制片过程的人共享。§§author n. 作者 v. 创作（a study authored by…）；authorial adj. 作者的（authorial intent 作者意图）§§改例句2：句末「..」多了一个句点

30038§compliance§kəmˈplaɪəns§n. 遵守；合规；服从，顺从§While bioaccumulation of manufactured nanoparticles may be inherently worrisome, it has been hypothesized that CeO2-NP bioaccumulation in invertebrates like D. polymorpha could serve as a valuable proxy, obviating the need for manufacturers to conduct costly and intrusive sampling of vertebrate species such as rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss), commonly used in regulatory compliance testing for manipulative bioaccumulation, as environmental protection laws currently require.§虽然人造纳米颗粒的生物累积本身可能令人担忧，但有人假设，CeO2 纳米颗粒在 D. polymorpha 等无脊椎动物体内的累积可以作为有价值的替代指标，使制造商无需再对虹鳟等脊椎动物进行昂贵而具侵入性的取样——这类取样常用于法规**合规性**检测中的操控性生物累积评估，因为环保法目前有此要求。§… commonly used in regulatory compliance testing—for nanoparticle bioaccumulation, as environmental protection laws currently require.§……常用于监管**合规**测试——用于纳米颗粒生物累积检测，正如现行环保法律所要求的那样。§§regulatory compliance testing 法规合规性检测§心理与行为语境指按他人要求行事，与 conformity 近义，但更强调对规则的服从§改译文：漏译 CeO2-NP 与 D. polymorpha

30039§discrete§dɪˈskriːt§adj. 分离的；各自独立的；离散的§But other critics argue that the books should not be thought of as discrete texts with traditional beginnings and endings but as a single incredibly long work, similar to other multivolume stories, such as Anthony Powell's A Dance to the Music of Time.§但另一些批评者主张，这些书不应被视为有传统开头与结尾的**独立**文本，而应看作一部极其漫长的整体作品，类似安东尼·鲍威尔的《随时间之乐起舞》等其他多卷本小说。§§§§discrete units / texts 各自独立的单元 / 文本§与 discreet（谨慎的）同音异义、极易混淆；也区别于 concrete（具体的）§改译文：漏译作者 Anthony Powell，书名也不全

30040§dispersal§dɪˈspɜːsl§n. 散布；传播；分散（种子、个体、种群）§Scientists have proposed several possible explanations: fewer species of soil fungi available at the northern edges of the trees’ habitat, physical barriers blocking seed dispersal, or deer overgrazing preventing new trees from establishing.§科学家提出了几种可能的解释：树木栖息地北缘可利用的土壤真菌种类较少、物理屏障阻断了种子**传播**，或是鹿的过度啃食使新树无法成活。§Fortes-Lima and colleagues hypothesized that the Bantu expansion—the dispersal starting 4,000–5,000 ya of Bantu-speaking peoples (BSP) from an ancestral homeland in West-Central Africa across sub-Saharan Africa—followed the same pattern.§Fortes-Lima 及同事假设：班图扩张——约四五千年前，讲班图语的民族从中西非的祖居地**扩散**至撒哈拉以南非洲——也遵循同样的模式。§§seed dispersal 种子传播（真题核心搭配）；disperse v. 散布；消散；dispersion n. 分散；离差（真题另现 6 次）§§

30041§explicable§ɪkˈsplɪkəbl§adj. 可解释的；可说明的§Joel Brown and colleagues showed that high moonlight intensity inhibits the activity of the Arizona pocket mouse (Perognathus amplus), a result explicable in terms of benefits and costs: greater lunar intensity may not enable the mice to increase foraging success enough to offset the higher chance of detection by predatory owls or hawks.§Joel Brown 及同事表明，月光强度高会抑制亚利桑那囊鼠（Perognathus amplus）的活动，这一结果可从收益与成本的角度**得到解释**：更强的月光未必能让囊鼠把觅食成功率提高到足以抵消被捕食性猫头鹰或鹰隼发现的更高风险。§§§§explicable in terms of X 可从 X 的角度加以解释（真题 100% 落在这一句型）；inexplicable adj. 无法解释的（反义派生，常考）§与 explicit 形近异义：explicit 是「明确的」§

30042§longitudinal§ˌlɒŋɡɪˈtjuːdɪnl§adj. 纵向的，跨时段的（长期追踪）；经度的§But it is much more expensive to conduct a longitudinal study like the Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia Survey (HILDA), which looks at data for 25,000 people in Australia to find trends in economic well-being that can take a long time to develop.§但开展像澳大利亚「家庭、收入与劳动力动态」调查（HILDA）这样的**纵向研究**要昂贵得多——该调查追踪澳大利亚 25,000 人的数据，用以发现需要很长时间才能显现的经济福祉趋势。§As with most longitudinal studies, extensive funding support is needed for SAGE to collect the relevant data over timescales and at intervals that will support robust conclusions.§与多数**纵向研究**一样，SAGE 需要大量的经费支持，才能在足以支撑可靠结论的时间尺度和时间间隔上收集相关数据。§§longitudinal study / data 纵向研究 / 数据；longitude n. 经度§longitudinal（纵向研究）与 cross-sectional（横断面研究）是社科阅读常见对照；「经度的」与 latitudinal（纬度的）相对§

30043§mollusk§ˈmɒləsk§n. 软体动物§With a shell that measured 1.7 meters, the extinct mollusk Parapuzosia seppenradensis is the largest ammonite in the fossil record.§壳长达1.7米的已灭绝**软体动物** Parapuzosia seppenradensis，是化石记录中最大的菊石。§Over time, marine mollusks called nautilids continually add segments to their shells, and the chemical composition of each segment is influenced by the available materials in the surrounding water when the segment forms.§随着时间的推移，被称为鹦鹉螺类的海洋**软体动物**会不断向壳体添加新环节，而每一环节的化学组成都受该环节形成时周围水中可用物质的影响。§[构词] moll-（软的）+ -usc§molluscan adj. 软体动物的；ammonite n. 菊石（真题与 mollusk 同现）；crustacean n. 甲壳类；arthropod n. 节肢动物（真题并列类群词）§§

30044§nuance§ˈnjuːɑːns§n. 细微差别；微妙之处 v. 使有细微差别；细致地处理§The popularity of ningyo joruri was due to a puppetry method called sannin zukai, in which three puppeteers operated a single puppet that was large, detailed, and capable of extensive movement and nuanced emotional expression.§人偶净琉璃（ningyo joruri）之所以受欢迎，得益于一种名为「三人遣」（sannin zukai）的木偶操纵法：三名操纵者共同操控一个体积大、做工细的木偶，使其能做出大幅动作与**细腻**的情感表达。§Moving beyond a simple “present or absent” designation, researchers created a new classification system that allows for a nuanced understanding of bioluminescence in marine organisms that was unavailable under binary classification systems.§研究者超越了简单的「有 / 无」二分，建立了一套新的分类系统，从而对海洋生物的生物发光形成二元分类体系下不可能有的**细腻**理解。§§nuanced adj. 有细微差别的；精细入微的（真题 4 次）§与 nuisance 形近异义：nuisance 是「讨厌的人；麻烦事」§

30045§propulsive§prəˈpʌlsɪv§adj. 推进的；有推动力的；（节奏、叙事）推进感强的§Many artists associated with hyperpop, a movement in electronic music that emerged in the 2010s, conform to the model perfected by American musician Laura Les: bold synthesizer arrangements, propulsive beats, and electronically manipulated vocals.§与 2010 年代兴起的电子乐流派 hyperpop 相关的许多音乐人，都遵循美国音乐人 Laura Les 打磨成熟的范式：大胆的合成器编排、**极具推进感**的节拍，以及经电子处理的人声。§Their combination of lush synthesizer arrangements and propulsive beats with vocals electronically shifted in pitch below their natural range exemplifies the hyperpop sound.§他们把繁复的合成器编曲与**强劲**的节拍，与人声经电子变调至低于自然音域的处理相结合，正是超流行音乐的典型声效。§[构词] propel v. 推进 → propulsive adj.；写作中可引申为「叙事推进感强」§propulsive beats 强劲、推着听者往前走的节拍§§

30046§speculative§ˈspekjələtɪv§adj. 推测的，猜想的；投机的；（文学）推想的§In his introduction, Shurin defines cyberpunk as a subgenre of speculative fiction concerning “the influence of technology on the scale, the pace, or the pattern of human affairs”; however, some critics assert that Shurin’s definition is too broad to distinguish cyberpunk from science fiction more generally.§舒林在导言中把赛博朋克界定为**推想**小说的一个亚类型，关注技术对人类事务的规模、节奏或模式的影响；然而一些批评者认为，舒林的定义过于宽泛，无法把赛博朋克与更广义的科幻小说区分开来。§Speculative counterfactuals like these can be great fodder for stories, but they’re also commonly deployed by academic historians to better understand factors influencing historical events.§这类**思辨性**的反事实设想可以成为绝好的故事素材，但学院派历史学家也常用它们来更好地理解影响历史事件的因素。§§speculative fiction 推想小说（涵盖科幻、奇幻等）；speculative investment 投机性投资；speculative counterfactuals 推测性的反事实设想§§

30047§volatile§ˈvɒlətaɪl§adj. 易挥发的；（价格、行情）剧烈波动的；（情绪、局势）不稳定的 n. （常作复数）挥发物§Corrine Walsh and colleagues hypothesized that microbial communities could also affect plants’ flavor chemistry, including volatiles and secondary metabolites like glucosinolates.§Corrine Walsh 及同事假设，微生物群落也可能影响植物的风味化学，包括**挥发物**以及硫代葡萄糖苷等次生代谢物。§§§§volatile compounds 挥发性化合物；volatile metal mercury 易挥发的金属汞；a volatile temperament / situation 易变的脾气 / 动荡的局势；volatility n. 波动性；波动率（真题 3 次）§§改译文：原译文是另一句（Fl 与金表面）

30048§adorn§əˈdɔːn§v. 装饰；装点；使生色，为…增添光彩§In his Histories (circa 425 BCE), Herodotus writes of 3,000 chambers adorned with carved figures, a dozen courts flanked by white stone pillars, and many winding passages in the complex, characterizing it as a great labyrinth and “an unending marvel.”§希罗多德在《历史》（约公元前425年）中写道，这座建筑群有3000间**装饰着**雕刻人像的厅室、十几个两侧立有白色石柱的庭院，以及许多曲折的通道，他将其形容为一座大迷宫、一处无穷的奇观。§The project's unadorned geometric forms, typical of the modernist aesthetic, contrasted with the historically inspired architecture seen in his earlier projects in Guadalajara, such as the Cristo House.§该项目不加**修饰**的几何形式是现代主义美学的典型，与他早年在瓜达拉哈拉的历史风格建筑（如 Cristo 住宅）形成对比。§§be adorned with 装饰着…；adornment n. 装饰（品）；unadorned adj. 未经装饰的（真题反义形式）§与 adore 形近异义：adore 是「崇拜；喜爱」§

30049§adroit§əˈdrɔɪt§adj. 机敏的；灵巧的；（手法、应对）老练的，娴熟的§In his afterword to Crowley’s book Little, Big, Bloom praises how the novel adroitly blends what playwright Friedrich Schiller termed the naive and sentimental modes—while Schiller thought works could be classified as either naive (seeking to describe reality) or sentimental (seeking to develop ideas), Little, Big fuses both modes of writing.§在克劳利《小，大》的跋里，布鲁姆盛赞这部小说把剧作家席勒所谓「素朴」与「感伤」两种模式**娴熟**地融为一体——席勒认为作品要么是素朴的（力求描摹现实），要么是感伤的（力求阐发观念），而《小，大》将两种写作模式融合在一起。§In his afterword to Crowley's book Little, Big, Bloom argues that the novel adroitly blends what playwright Friedrich Schiller termed the naive and sentimental modes—while Schiller thought works could be classified as either naive (seeking to describe reality) or sentimental (seeking to develop ideas), Little, Big fuses both modes of writing.§在为 Crowley 的小说《Little, Big》所作的跋中，Bloom 论证这部小说**巧妙**地融合了剧作家席勒所称的「素朴」与「感伤」两种模式——席勒认为作品非素朴（力求描摹现实）即感伤（力求阐发观念），而《Little, Big》将两种写作模式熔于一炉。§[构词] adroitly adv. 已并入本词条统一计数；反义 maladroit（笨拙的）§an adroit blend 巧妙的融合；an adroit negotiator 老练的谈判者§§改译文：漏译括号里两种模式的定义，后半句「证明二者可以兼得」按原文改译

30050§causality§kɔːˈzæləti§n. 因果关系；因果性§Yuen Yuen Ang has recently argued that both positions presume linear causality in situations in which neither phenomenon is truly independent of the other.§洪源远（Yuen Yuen Ang）最近指出，两种立场都预设了线性**因果关系**，而在这些情形中，两种现象其实都不真正独立于彼此。§To carry out the necessary sampling of the population over many years, CLSA-ÉLCV needs extensive financial support, but this method provides valuable insights into causal relationships.§要在多年间对人群进行必要的抽样，CLSA-ÉLCV 需要大量经费支持，但这一方法能为**因果关系**提供宝贵的洞见。§§linear causality 线性因果；causal adj. 因果的；causally adv. 因果地；cause n. 原因§causality ≠ correlation（相关性），是 SAT 科学类文章的核心对立§
